Corrections

The Register requests a fix with a reason. The teacher resubmits as a new revision.

Published means final

Students and safety

Safe by design

Student access is limited and every important action is recorded.

Protection

  • Role-based access, enforced by the server
  • Password re-entry to approve or publish
  • Published results cannot be altered
  • Complete audit log of changes

Messaging

  • No private chat between students
  • Students message their own teachers only
  • Reports and moderation by the Headmaster
  • Notices to a class, role or the whole school
